title: Delegation created
description: The model delegated work. Correlation data only: it carries no task text, and it grants no authority.

event_id.description: Provider-assigned identifier for this server event.

client_event_id.description: The event_id of the broker command this event answers, when the broker supplied one.

offset_ms.description: Where the delegation was created in milliseconds from the start of the session timeline.

id.description: Opaque delegation ID. Return it unchanged; never construct or parse one. That it belongs to this session is the broker's precondition to check, not this schema's.

target.description: Pinned. The session selects client delegation, so a responses target would contradict the negotiated configuration; such an event fails this schema and is dropped as unknown rather than acted on. The provider field response_id, which accompanies a responses delegation, is excluded for the same reason.
